sloka: पवन आहत वेगाभिः ऊर्मिभिः विमले अंभसि ।पन्कजानि विराजन्ते ताड्यमानानि लक्ष्मण  ॥४-१-६६॥
transliteration: pavana āhata vegābhiḥ ūrmibhiḥ vimale aṁbhasi ।pankajāni virājante tāḍyamānāni lakṣmaṇa  ॥4-1-66॥

translations.english: 'Unable to see my beloved with eyes large like totus petals and an ardent lover of lotuses, I have no desire to live.
